about: Pete serves up another Hot Mix for Radio 1...

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 22 Dec. Mella Dee brings his ice cold sounds to the Hot Mix. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1 Dance.
items.title: Mella Dee

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 15 Dec. Adam Beyer celebrates 30 years of his label Drumcode in the Hot Mix for Pete Tong. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1 Dance.
items.title: Adam Beyer

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 1 Dec. Pete rewinds Dutch dance music royalty ANOTR's Hot Mix in celebration of ADE. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1 Dance.
items.title: ANOTR

name: Pete Tong's Hot Mix
